items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Through Lew Leslie. He wanted to get all colored entertainment for the show. He got Ethel Waters, he got The Berry Brothers, Buck and Bubbles...

ctx.x: How did you get that job?
Through Lew Leslie. He wanted to get all colored entertainment for the show. He got Ethel Waters, he got The Berry Brothers, Buck and Bubbles and oh, several others.
Wasn't Bill Robinson also in it?
